end.summary: Identified top, front and side views of solids in 3 unaided attempts.
end.parentNote: Reyansh practised describing and matching top, front and side views, including circles, rectangles and triangles. They used the method of imagining the object from a particular viewing place and correctly matched all five views. They mixed up visible details with details known to be on an object; this was discussed when considering a cup handle, but the mix-up was seen again later. At home, practise drawing one object from two different viewing positions and include only the parts visible from each position.
